notes: The date is also stated in verse in the chronogram 'ṣaḍ-vindu-vaśvaṃ [vasu] kṛte nepālīyamate' (806 NS) in Jyeṣṭha kṛṣṇa amāvasyā (amānta Vaiśākha kṛṣṇa). The phrase 'līlādāsa vayusmata...' is corrupt and unclear whether 'līlādāsa' denotes a person or a textual descriptor.
